tape_read.note: Robust reference 7.5338 (-5.71% vs prev close 7.99), 39 prints, 10 in the last 30 min, last at 09:15, not stale. After-hours was -7.37%, pre-market high 7.9068 (-1.0%), low 7.46, so it has recovered from the after-hours low. Market is risk-on (QQQ +1.9%, IWM +0.9%). My frozen read was +4.0%: the market is trading the revenue miss and not the backlog, a gap of ~10 points against the release read, i.e. an overshoot to the downside. Position is -2.9% from the 13:30 entry.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was that backlog would break its $110.9m stall; it rose 20% to $132.9m. The miss is on revenue (timing of conversion), which the panel did not size.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (10 prints in the last 30 min, last at 09:15) so the open should hold most of the -5.7%; a gap beyond the implied move against a release whose key line (backlog) confirmed, in a strong tape, should give some back by 10:00.

Zo'n daling voorbij de verwachte beweging zakt na de opening vaak deels terug, dus verkoop om 10:00 in plaats van bij de opening.
